description: This file defines the 'Extension' model class within the Opencart system, providing methods to retrieve extension information from the database such as all extensions, extensions by type, extensions by code, and installation details.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Model class for managing extension-related database operations within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of distinct extension identifiers from the database.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves all extensions from the database filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Retrieves extension data based on type and code.
